letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this wild, beautiful life with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on that February day, and how our laughter echoed across continents. No distance can dim the glow of our love; it only makes our moments together sweeter. Thank you for being my anchor, my adventure, and my endless source of joy. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
Across the dunes and the river’s song,  
Your love is where my heart belongs.  
From desert heat to monsoon rain,  
With you, my jaan, I’m whole again.
